description: CR 603.3d Necrotic Plague: with no creature an opponent of the dead creature's controller controls, the trigger has no target and the Plague stays in the graveyard
note: Bob's Bears die to the granted upkeep trigger; the only other creature is bob's own Piker, which a target relative to alice, the trigger's controller, would admit. Nothing is legal for bob, so the trigger is removed (ruling 2010-08-15) and the Plague stays in alice's graveyard, the Piker unenchanted.
